metadata.case_name: YEUNG WAI KIT v. POON PAK HO

injuries.description: CT scan of orbit showed fractured right orbital floor, ethmoid anterior, medial and lateral walls of right maxillary sinuses and right zygoma.
injuries.body_part: right orbital floor, ethmoid and right maxillary sinuses and right zygoma
source: CT scan of orbit showed fractured right orbital floor, ethmoid anterior, medial and lateral walls of right maxillary sinuses and right zygoma.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

injuries.description: Right eye subconjunctival haemorrhage, right periorbital swelling and right infraorbital numbness.
source: He was diagnosed to suffer from right eye subconjunctival hemorrhage, right periorbital swelling and right infraorbital numbness.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of eyeball or orbital tissues

source: After suturing of his lip laceration on 2 Apr 2013, the Plaintiff was discharged from PWH on 3 Apr 2013.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of head

injuries.description: Fracture of proximal phalanx of left ring and left little fingers; deformed left hand.
injuries.body_part: left ring and left little fingers; left hand
source: deformed left hand and left ring finger and left little finger (X-ray of left hand showed fracture of proximal phalanx of left ring and left little fingers)
the plaintiff broke one upper molar in the accident and was advised to seek restoration in private sector

manifestations.description: bruise on forehead and below right eye
residual stiffness and weakness of left ring and little fingers; mild residual finger stiffness and gripping weakness
mild reduction in power for left injured fingers; difficulty lifting heavy objects with left injured fingers
scar on upper left lip said to be 1cm in length
4cm and 3cm long scars on the back of his left ring and little fingers
nightmares, poor sleep and avoidance behaviours (post-traumatic stress reactions)
no diplopia with full extraocular mobility; visual acuity 20/13 OU

treatments_received: Admission to Accident & Emergency and neurosurgical ward of Prince of Wales Hospital
Consultation at Department of Ophthalmology & Visual Sciences of PWH
Open reduction of maxillary fracture (dental surgery) on 11 Apr 2013
Open reduction and internal fixation of left 2 finger fractures on 16 Apr 2013
Physiotherapy (ice therapy, electrotherapy, mobilization and strengthening exercises) from 30 Apr 2013 to 9 Aug 2013
Occupational therapy and splintage for protecting fracture site from 16 Apr 2013; splints advised to stop in Jun 2013
Outpatient follow-up at Department of Orthopedics & Traumatology and eye clinic
Referral to Li Ka Shing Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic for post-traumatic stress reactions (one appointment, defaulted follow-up)

losses.description: Residual stiffness, weakness and reduced power of left ring and little fingers causing difficulty lifting heavy objects and gripping weakness.
Scars on the back of left ring and little fingers (4cm and 3cm) with minimal cosmetic disability.
Scar on upper left lip (1cm) with minimal cosmetic significance.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Nightmares, poor sleep and avoidance behaviours as post-traumatic stress reactions following the accident.
